FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 264
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Tim Wadsworth
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/11/2023
House Bill 264as introduced provides for the suspension of a driver's license by court order,
under certain conditions, for (1) violation of written bond to appear or failure to appear in court
for an initial court appearance, (2) failure to appear in court for a traffic violation post
adjudication compliance review, or (3) failure to pay at least 6 court ordered payments for fines,
fees, or court costs as a result of a traffic violation.
Further the provisions of this bill could also reduce receipts to the various funds that court costs,
fines, and fees are distributed to, by an undetermined amount, dependent upon the number of
individuals that fail to pay court costs, fines, and fees, pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
In addition, this bill could increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Law
Enforcement Agency and the Supreme Court of Alabama to adopt rules to implement the
provisions of this bill.
